systems.country_label: Centro do Sistema Integrado de Informação Criminal (SIIC)
systems.platform: Built under the West African Police Information System programme (SIPAO/WAPIS), to which the Polícia Judiciária's director says it connects
systems.owner: Polícia Judiciária, under the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights; ECOWAS and European Union representatives present
systems.tiers: One reformulated centre inaugurated 9 March 2023 at the Polícia Judiciária's national directorate in Bissau; the director says it works in the Polícia Judiciária and will also be in the Guarda Nacional, its fiscal-action brigade, the Polícia de Ordem Pública and the migration services; no station or post outside the centre is named

note: No fact: the document describes the SIIC as a specialised centre that collects, processes and disseminates criminal information and lets police and investigative agencies exchange it, giving real-time access to information on crimes, criminals and suspects; it does not say that stations enter reports or cases in it, so it is not classed record. The class is a judgement between exchange and identification, and the parent may prefer the other.
